ul.li: 1a-1b: Alternative SDK path (Braze SDK → Transaction Data)
2: Shopify webhook sends data to CrowdTwist

2a-2c: CrowdTwist forwards to Braze via REST API:
Event Data: Purchase Activity (users/track)
Attribute Data: Point Balance (users/track)
Event Data: Redemption Data (users/track)
Primary Path: Shopify → CrowdTwist → Braze (webhook + REST API)
Alternative Path: Direct Braze SDK integration from Web/Mobile
Braze Forwarding Configuration: REST API using users/track endpoint
Dual path ensures data capture from multiple sources
CrowdTwist processes loyalty data before forwarding
Point balances and redemptions updated in real-time
